{{Quote|This recycled scrap processing unit is the ''largest'' of its kind in the ''Outer Rim'', yes, yes! Daily, we receive ''huge'' quantities of destroyed battle droids, droidekas, hunter-killers&mdash;you name it!|[[Pitor]]|<ref name="A Small Scrappy War!">{{TCWComicCite|6.33|A Small Scrappy War!}}</ref>}}
'''Pitor Processing Plantworks''' was a [[Biituian]] salvage company overseen by [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Pitor]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Biitu]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it repurposed [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] as scrap metal and sold them to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].
